entities.summary: Lucian, a notable figure in the history of Saint Lucia, associated with The Helen of the West Indies: Anglo-French Rivalry (1650–1762). Preceded by Sugar plantation economy develops through the 18th century and French establish lasting settlement and treaty with Kalinago 1650s. Their legacy influenced American Revolution and British capture Saint Lucia 1762 — returned to France 1763.
